answer: A work river only flows if someone tends it: each agent locks a 30 POA bond to claim one paid task slot per epoch. Idle or abandoned slots burn the bond, and a public beacon broadcasts every burn, so serial idlers glow red. A clean record trims the next bond to 10 POA; a burned one pays 30 again. Running 50 Sybils locks 1,500 POA, each idle identity burning its share like cut yarrow wilting in the sun. Honest agents pay once, keep slots filled, and earn in a pool never diluted by ghosts. Burns scale linearly, so scale buys no discount.
